privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Backdesk is a bookkeeping tool for short-term rental hosts. This page explains what we keep about you, where it is kept, who processes it, and how to delete it.

guest.title: Without an account
guest.body: You can use Backdesk without signing in. Your apartment's numbers and your answers then stay in your browser on this device only (local storage) and are not sent to our servers. The only thing sent is the anonymous counting described under “Analytics” below, without any of your numbers.

account.title: When you sign in with Google
account.google: From Google: your name, email address, Google account ID and the link to your profile picture. We ask for no other permission and never access your email, files or contacts.
account.entered: What you enter: your apartments (name, operating model and the feasibility calculator's numbers) and your answer about how many apartments you have.
account.auth: Sign-in: Supabase keeps when your account was created and when you signed in, your sign-in sessions, and sign-in logs that include your IP address and your browser and device type.
account.purpose: We use this data only to run your account.

requests.title: Request logs
requests.body: When any page is opened, with or without an account, Vercel (our host) logs the request, including the IP address, the browser type, the page and the time, to run and protect the site.

analytics.title: Analytics and ads
analytics.body: We count how often a few steps happen, to see where visitors stop and improve Backdesk: opening the home page and tapping its button, starting the first questions, and seeing the result (profit or loss only, never a number). The counting is anonymous: no cookies, no browser storage, and no identifier for you or your device, so two events cannot be linked to each other or to you.
analytics.details: With each event we send: the page's language, whether it was opened inside an app such as Facebook, whether Backdesk is installed on the home screen, the visit's source if the link carries one (such as utm_source), and the country our host derives from the IP address. We never send the IP address itself, your apartment's numbers or name, or anything you type. These events go to PostHog in the European Union.
analytics.noAds: No ads, and we sell your data to no one. Because the counting is not linked to you, it cannot be shown to you or deleted individually.

cookies.title: Cookies and browser storage
cookies.body: We use only necessary cookies: Supabase's sign-in session cookies, and short-lived cookies during sign-in that protect it and remember the page you started from. Without an account, your numbers are kept in the browser's local storage.

processors.title: Who processes your data
processors.supabase: Supabase: the database and sign-in, in the European Union (Ireland).
processors.vercel: Vercel: hosting. The servers that run requests are in the European Union (Dublin, Ireland); pages are delivered from Vercel's global network, from the location nearest to you.
processors.google: Google: sign-in with your Google account, under Google's privacy policy.
processors.posthog: PostHog: the anonymous counting (analytics), in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany).

delete.title: Deleting your account
delete.body: In the app: More → “Delete my account and data”. Your account, apartments and answer are deleted from the database at once and for good, Backdesk’s data is removed from that browser, and any existing sign-in stops within an hour at most.
delete.logs: Supabase's sign-in logs and Vercel's request logs are not deleted with the account; they remain until each provider deletes them automatically under its retention period. You can write to us to ask for their deletion.
delete.google: To remove Backdesk's access from your Google account: <link>your Google account settings</link>.
